title: ononis microphylla
intro: Ononis microphylla, commonly known as Dwarf Spanish Clover or Pygmy Burnet, is a species of flowering plant in the legume family, Fabaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, and is used to support cardiovascular health, reduce the risk of certain diseases, and alleviate symptoms of various conditions. The therapeutic actions of Ononis microphylla are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit vasodilatory effects, and act as an antispasmodic. The bioactive constituents of Ononis microphylla include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
